title: Labor Allowance on Out-of-Area Tire Repairs
content:
Under Road Hazard Protection, the dismount, remount and balance on an outside shop's repair receipt are reimbursed according to what the plan includes. The allowance figures are the per-tire charges of the covered set's tire line.

**Repair labor allowance.** On a plan that replaces a TPMS sensor destroyed by a road hazard free, the dismount, remount and balance on the receipt are reimbursed at the tire line's mount-and-balance charge per tire plus its TPMS service kit charge per tire; on a plan that does not, but that includes mounting and balancing on a replacement, at the mount-and-balance charge per tire; on any other plan no labor allowance is paid.

The allowance is added to the out-of-area repair reimbursement.

| Plan | TPMS sensor damage covered | Mounting included on a replacement | Labor allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Road Hazard Plus 36-Month Protection | yes | yes | mount-and-balance charge plus TPMS kit charge |
| Crestline Road Hazard Life-of-Tread Protection | yes | yes | mount-and-balance charge plus TPMS kit charge |
| Crestline Road Hazard 36-Month Protection | no | yes | mount-and-balance charge |
| Crestline Road Hazard Commercial LT Protection | no | yes | mount-and-balance charge |
| Crestline Road Hazard 24-Month Protection | no | no | none |
| Crestline Road Hazard 12-Month Protection | no | no | none |

*Hypothetical figures.* A line with a 20.00 mount-and-balance charge and a 5.99 TPMS kit charge: 25.99 on the Plus 36-Month and Life-of-Tread plans, 20.00 on the 36-Month and Commercial LT plans.
